story_sequence.text: `beacon-implement` remains the only public implementation skill; mode-specific public skills are not introduced.
Human-facing playbooks define purpose, admission, command, evidence, and boundary for `single`, `team`, and `ralph`.
Help/status can recommend `single`, `team`, or `ralph` based on scope, complexity, closure needs, and risk.
Ralph is documented as a closure controller that routes next action; it does not replace QA, release, gate, or frozen truth.
Mode recommendations include the reason and canonical `beacon implement run "<feature>" --project . --version <version> --mode <mode>` command.
Skill Eval Kit includes cases for normal implementation, team/subagent implementation, and Ralph closure prompts.
Prompts implying `beacon-implement-single`, `beacon-implement-team`, or `beacon-implement-ralph` do not create or route to those public skills.
Mode playbooks and recommendations cannot rewrite PRD, user-story, test-case, freeze state, QA verdict, release verdict, or gate verdict.
